        This file contains death records from the Bessarabian villages
        of South Russia for the period 1870-1879. (No records are available
        for 1872 or 1873)  This information was compiled by R. Reuben Drefs,
        coordinator and volunteers La Rose Ketterling, Le Roy Dockter, Darlene
        Drefs and Jan Stangl from the St. Petersburg Lutheran Evangelical
        archives published by the LDS.
        Edited by Marty McMahon.
